basic_info.description: This Lower Nob Hill residence captures amazing morning light and sweeping views of the city skyline from both the expansive living/dining area and spacious bedroom. The kitchen opens to the main living space, while a refreshed bath and oversized entry closet enhance comfort and function. Elegant  floors, parking, and private storage elevate the home's appeal. Pine Terrace, a mid-century elevator building, offers an attended doorman lobby, panoramic rooftop deck, laundry with skyline views, residents' lounge and library, secured courtyard, and package concierge. Perfectly positioned near Union Square, Polk Gulch, the Theater District, North Beach, and Russian Hill, with Grace Cathedral, Huntington Park, Whole Foods, and Trader Joe's just steps away. This home delivers a sophisticated urban lifestyle with all the perks.
